Shutdown invokes docker exec in that same container: pg_ctl stop -m fast -w -t15. The controller requires this waiting exec to return0 before it accepts external attach/EOF/native closure.
Normal success is strict: exec0 followed by attach0, full log EOF, exact native exited/PID0/exit0/noOOM state and deadline. A shutdown exec137 must remain overallFAIL.

mechanismAssessment.explanation: The intended success event is exit of postgres/PID1, while pg_ctl -w remains inside that same PID namespace waiting for shutdown completion. Under ordinary Linux PID-namespace/container lifecycle semantics, termination of namespace init tears down remaining namespace processes; the waiting exec can be killed before it reports completion. Thus clean postmaster exit and exec137 are compatible. A Docker container die event is emitted after lifecycle processing and is not a kernel ordering proof.
